description: This file defines a protocol 'SimpleFileWatcherOwner' with a property 'watcher' of type 'SimpleFileWatcher'. It also provides an extension with default implementations for 'start' and 'stop' methods that call corresponding methods on the watcher instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file watcher by invoking the start method on the watcher instance.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file watcher by invoking the stop method on the watcher instance.
